product_metadata.title: MCombo Large Power Swivel Glider Rocker Recliner Chair with Massage and Heat for Nursery and USB Ports, Cup Holders and Pockets, Faux Leather 7748 (Cream White, Large)
features: Power Recliner & Swivel Glider:The chair swivels at 270 degrees and moves back and forth horizontally, it’s an ideal choice if you are nursing or need to be somewhat mobile while using the recliner. And you can adjust the chair to a reclining position you prefer by the remote control.

Full-Body Vibration & Lumbar Heat: It has 8 built-in vibrating points and 1 lumbar heating point, coming with 4 modes and 3 intensities, which allows you to customize the most suitable combination to relieve muscle pain and atrophy after long hours' work. Both can be terminated under alternative settings of 10/20/30 minutes. (Heating function works with vibration separately.)
Large Seats: The wider seat size provides you with a more comfortable experience. Seat Size:21” * 25”
Easy to Assemble: Depending on the unique structure and wiring design, it's simple to assemble the chair, no tools needed. (15 minutes for a novice)

2 USB ports & 2 Cup holders: With the help of the USB ports, keep your must-have devices fully charged and close to you. Meanwhile, put your drink on the cup holder when you relaxing on the chair and watching TV. (ONLY for low-power devices, such as mobile phone.)

IMPORTANT NOTE: 1. Delivery: The chair comes in 3 boxes and we ship them on the same day but the carrier may deliver on different days. 2.Please feel free to contact us if your recliner has any shipping damage. 3. Max reclining angle: 140°. 4. Recommended Height: 5'1"-5'9".
